reviews.review: One of my old favorite games remade and polished for modern standards. Too bad Take Two had to ruin this game for me with their spyware-esque changes to the EULA. I cannot recommend this game, nor any other game Take Two is a part of due to how invasive their new TOS are to your privacy.

Not a good rogue like, really bad balanced and very boring.
First the characters, the game has 15 characters which 3 of them are absolute monsters and the other 12 are just completely useless, if you want to use them do it but in a lower difficulty because monsoon is just no well made for this guys.
Second the items, half of them you never gonna use them, there's no point to do it because they dont help you at all and you are gonna end using the same always, especially if you get the item that let you decided what you get.
Third the difficulty of the game, they are 3 options, the first 2 are easy as hell but the third one is an absolute joke, is practically instakills and hundreds of monsters with gigantic bars of health that are going to keep respawning until you activate the teleport, and that really doesnt help, beacuse the maps are unnecesary long and dont have a limit of how many enemies can be on the map so that gonna leave u with a swarm of enemies that can kill you in 2 or 3 hits if they didn't make u instakill already.
Four is really stupid decision of desing, why the hell you let me chosee between 3 dificulties if there's a option where i can choose myself how much damage the player does and how much damage the enemies can deal to the player is just plain ridiculous, instead of making a good difficulty curve they just put the a lazy option to make the player fix the difficulty problem himself.
Finally the fun, the game becomes boring really fast and there's not too much to do, the maps are really long for no reason, empty and always the same, the runs dont have a purpose once you unlock all the characters and are really frustrating since yo can pass one hour picking up items just to die in the next stage beacuse of a instakill, and since there's no a purpose the game doesn't give a you a reason to keep playing.
And thats all, its just my personal opinion based on my experience in the game and maybe i am wrong, if you ask me if a recomend the game, my answer is NO unless you have some friends to play it or you get the game for a really low price like 5 or 6 bucks.
Btw they should call this game Risk of Legs because the amount of times that you are going to brake ur legs is insane.

it feels like this game is much too overshadowed by risk of rain 2, but as it's own game it's quite incredible. It has a good bit of customization and unlike ror2 whereyou can easily manipulate the geometry to avoid attacks, you're much more forced to combat the enemies in this game. There's no real huge flaws in the design, if you liked ror2 and wanted more of it but didn't wanna play after seekers of the storm released, this is totally perfect. It also helps introduce the original story to fans of ror2 who would have missed out, since the final boss of ror2 isn't even mentioned here (I think)

It's a hollow remake. Risk of Rain Returns fails to meaningfully improve upon the original while carrying over all its flaws. Maps are excessively large with inadequate movement options, combat isn't necessarily fun or good, a lot of the items just don't tell you what they do, and an obscene amount of bugs exist, ranging from annoying to game-breaking. Multiplayer is nearly unplayable with frequent disconnects and poor chest scaling that leaves you item-starved.

Hopoo and Gearbox's promises of continued support through an "updated codebase" have proven empty - just 5 patches and zero content updates. The promised mod support? Never materialized.

This is particularly galling given how Hopoo abandoned Risk of Rain 2 to Gearbox after selling out, letting both games deteriorate into buggy, unbalanced messes.

The same incompetence that ruined Risk of Rain 2 is evident here.
better than 2 in every way, change my mind
